SELL_AT_OPEN TECHM 140 against 139 held is BLOCKED with both numbers
SELL_AT_OPEN TIPSMUSIC 334 (all of it): simulated fill, the position CLOSED
SELL_AT_OPEN OAL 132 PARTIAL: a third sold, the position stays OPEN
ARM_GTT TECHM after its GTT went missing: the backstop re-arms the stop (non-negotiable 4)
